name: Default
shortDescription: FlareSolverr-compatible API that loads pages in a stealth Firefox to pass Cloudflare and other anti-bot challenges, returning HTML and cookies to Prowlarr, Jackett or Open WebUI.

alerts.message: Byparr has no authentication, so this template only answers under a secret path. Use https://<your-domain>/<BYPARR_TOKEN>/ as the FlareSolverr URL in Prowlarr or Jackett (or https://<your-domain>/<BYPARR_TOKEN>/load as the Open WebUI external web loader), where the token is the generated value in the environment settings; every other path returns 404. Keep the token private: anyone who has it can make the server browse any URL.
